about.en: Dogelon Mars (ELON) is a community-run, dog-themed meme token launched in 2021 as an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x761d38e5ddf6ccf6cf7c55759d5210750b5d60f3, with bridged deployments on Polygon, BNB Chain, Solana and other chains. Holders use it to vote on the project's community proposals; it has no issuer backing.
